title: Hilary Duff’s Lucky Me Tour Setlist: Every Song She Played on Night 1 in Florida
summary: “You guys have made this all possible for me," the singer/actress said, thanking the crowd.
contentText:
This is definitely what dreams are made of.

Hilary Duff has finally kicked off her Lucky Me Tour, opening with a shimmering first show at iTHINK Financial Amphitheatre on Sunday night in West Palm Beach, Florida.

Complete with a variety of chic stage looks and dreamy lighting effects, the singer/actress’ long-awaited first night on the road featured a setlist spanning her career, from her Lizzie McGuire days to her most recent album, 2026’s Luck … or Something . Before the show was done, concertgoers were treated to a pyrotechnic-filled sendoff as Duff belted out timeless classic “What Dreams Are Made Of,” complete with a shower of sparks, explosions of confetti and beach balls.

Following a limited run of intimate performances on her Small Rooms, Big Nerves mini-tour, Duff is now officially back on the road for her first full-scale tour in nearly two decades. It serves as a victory lap celebrating the success of Luck … or Something , which — despite being 10 years separating it from her last album, 2015’s Breathe In. Breathe Out. — reached No. 3 on the Billboard 200 .

“You guys have made this all possible for me,” she gushed at one point Sunday night, thanking the fans in the audience. “It feels like such a celebration of our past younger selves to now and who we are. This just feels so full circle and so exciting.”

After another night at the West Palm Beach amphitheater, Duff will continue her trek with performances across the United States before embarking on legs in Europe, Australia and Canada. Whether you’re planning on catching a show or just want to see which of Duff’s songs made it onto the setlist, check out all the tracks she played on night one of her Lucky Me Tour below.
